title: Ratchet & Clank: A Crack in Time
executable_kind: AnyPS3 analysis ELF reconstructed from verified SELF load segments
notes: Native startup executes four original RSX clears and four headless black flips at 1280x720, then initializes FIOS, reads actual PSARC archives and writes real cache.idx/cache.dat files. The original AOT SPU code decompresses game.toc (136620 bytes), verified byte-for-byte against independent zlib decoding. DMA spans adjacent guest mappings and mailbox events notify the PPU. The default diagnostic per-SPU budget is 10000000 instructions; ANYPS3_SPU_MAX_STEPS allows an explicit positive uint64 budget. Startup with 500000000 reaches over 117 million PPU steps. PPU NaN propagation and gradual underflow are implemented with integer rounding and independently checked FPSCR status. No menu, game shaders, geometry or gameplay yet. Exact original game/firmware callback descriptors and SPU overlays are statically translated; unknown execution remains a diagnostic stop. Vulkan supports tiled ARGB8 and packed Z24S8 clears with two horizontal samples, reports, real-time vblank and headless scanout. SDL2 input remains native. vrefp still uses a rounded reciprocal rather than the Cell estimate table. See docs/ratchet-acit-loading-milestone.md, docs/menu-progress.md and docs/vulkan-rendering.md.
